message.content: {"mentions":[{"ref":"m1","surface":"阿Q","occurrence":0},{"ref":"m2","surface":"阿Q","occurrence":1},{"ref":"m3","surface":"阿Q","occurrence":2},{"ref":"m4","surface":"阿Q","occurrence":3},{"ref":"m5","surface":"阿Q","occurrence":4}],"relations":[{"subject_ref":"m1","object_ref":"m2","type":"同伙","evidence":[{"quote":"這晚上照例有一臺戲，戲臺左近，也照例有許多的賭攤。","occurrence":0}]},{"subject_ref":"m3","object_ref":"m4","type":"冲突","evidence":[{"quote":"他不知道誰和誰爲什麽打起架來了。","occurrence":0},{"quote":"他纔爬起來，賭攤不見了，人們也不見了，身上有幾處很似乎有些痛，似乎也挨了幾拳幾腳似的，幾個人詫異的對他看。","occurrence":1}]},{"subject_ref":"m5","object_ref":"m4","type":"欺凌","evidence":[{"quote":"他這回纔有些感到失敗的苦痛了。","occurrence":0}]}],"alias_proposals":[]}
